scientific_integrity: Independent validation has not been performed. Finite-field checks corroborate but do not replace the all-size proof.
scientific_limitations: The uniform pointwise smoothness criterion is proved; nonreduced singular scheme, arbitrary completed singular germs and global deformation theory are not addressed. Standard binomial-edge prime decomposition and Grassmannian adjunction are prior results; equivalent literature might exist.
title: Cyclic Plücker complete intersections: an exact smoothness criterion and low-dimensional models
